props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text after every keystroke and every accepted suggestion.

props.name: getSuggestion
props.description: Returns what should follow the text — only the continuation, not the text itself. May return a promise; the signal aborts when the text changes before it settles, and a late answer is ignored either way.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Quiet time after the last keystroke before asking, in milliseconds.

props.name: multiline
props.description: A textarea instead of a single line.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called with the part of a suggestion that was accepted.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Pair with a Field for a visible one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the generated id. Field supplies one.

props.name: 'aria-describedby'
props.description: Extra descriptions, such as a Field hint.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins; targets the wrapper.
